name: neo-angband-mod-forge
description: ModForge: author a Neo Angband mod from inside the game, without a text editor
author: neostryder (RPGM Tools)
//private: Not published to npm, and not intended to be. A mod is distributed as a FOLDER the
game fetches - manifest.json plus plugin.js, at a tag, verified against a digest
that ships inside the game. npm is not in that path, and publishing would create a
second way to get this mod that nothing checks.
//dependencies: The engine is a devDependency, never a dependency. plugin.js receives it as
ctx.core at load time; a runtime dependency would mean a second copy of the
engine's module state living inside the mod, which this mod refuses outright.
So it is here for TYPES and for the tests.
The mod SDK is different here than in every other mod in this family: this mod
CALLS it at runtime rather than only building against it. It still is not a runtime
dependency, for the same reason core is not - plugin.js resolves no specifier. The
authoring functions arrive on ctx.authoring, a separate namespace core hands in
alongside ctx.core rather than through it, and the SDK is here for types, for the

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check
